name: cristianabrante-resume
description: Multi-format resume generation from JSON Resume

scripts.generate:pdf: mkdir -p cv/output && typst compile cv/cv.typ cv/output/cv-cristian-abrante.pdf --root . --font-path cv/fonts --pdf-standard ua-1
scripts.watch:pdf: mkdir -p cv/output && typst watch cv/cv.typ cv/output/cv-cristian-abrante.pdf --root . --font-path cv/fonts --pdf-standard ua-1
scripts.preview:website: npm run generate:pdf && npm run generate:website && node scripts/preview-website.js
scripts.generate:all: npm run generate:readme && npm run generate:pdf && npm run generate:website && npm run generate:signature
